items.text: People can know truth by trusting legitimate authorities.
Expert authority is a reliable source of knowledge.
Longstanding traditions are a trustworthy guide to what is true.
Wisdom from ancestors is a valid source of knowledge.
Direct sensory experience is a reliable way to know the world.
What we observe with our senses is the foundation of knowledge.
Logical reasoning can reveal truths independent of observation.
Reason alone can establish what is true.
Scientific methods are the most reliable way to gain knowledge.
Systematic observation and testing yield trustworthy truths.
Intuition can be a valid source of knowledge.
Some truths are known directly without reasoning.
Divination can reveal real knowledge about the world.
Methods like omens or oracles can convey truth.
Revelation from a divine source can provide genuine knowledge.
Sacred revelation is a trustworthy source of truth.
There are no reliable sources of knowledge.
Any claim to knowledge is ultimately uncertain or invalid.
